entry_points.text: Top builder validates non-empty input, builds per-CPU chains, assigns cache IDs, builds groups, inits sharing and attaches under read-side section; attach prunes degenerate levels; migration moves runqueue to new root under queue lock; refresh records cache, NUMA and asym pointers ordered; deadline reattach adds bandwidth under pool lock unless unattached or empty.
Migration starts scheduling on boot CPU; arch topology refresh defaults to success; fair class prepares balancing masks and softirq; pressure init honors enable controls and prepares system group.

exports.text: Deadline and priority trackers provide create/teardown with ordered rollback; bandwidth init derives allowance from global realtime controls; server binding links entity, runqueue and callback.
Domain mask arrays allocate per entry with reverse rollback and symmetric free; sysctl dirty helper marks the CPU in the global set when present.
Scheduler exposes sched/lock address classification, global root task group, per-CPU current-task accessor, and thread-wide normalization to normal policy.

hazards.text: Empty input or insane spans warn and abort with zero success and negative no-memory failure; group failure aborts; malformed non-subset spans repair by union while partial non-NUMA overlap fails; any provisioning exhaustion unwinds reverse; capacities use base scale; deadline/priority use invalid markers with fixed levels; negative RT means unlimited else scaled to nanoseconds.

Sleeping-context checks report blocking outside running state, mismatched preemption or RCU nesting, disabled interrupts, idle context, nonblocking sections, corrupted stacks or held locks with rate limiting and boot/shutdown exclusions; atomic and migrate checks report wrongly assumed context.
Construction and init rely on external cpumask, percpu, atomic, locking, topology, diagnostic and time helpers specified elsewhere.

invariants.text: Unassigned cache ID is -1; CPU reuses sibling low-level ID else allocates lowest free tracking max; per-CPU counters sized max+1 keep size and scaled bytes only when sharing exists; stub variant always fails; effective bytes scale HW size else zero; single-member cache never aggregates.

Single-CPU span is degenerate; multi-group dependent flags or wake affinity prevent it; parent degeneracy uses span equality and flag coverage ignoring single-group flags; lowest returns first carrier, highest returns last but stops early when shared downward; debug checks containment, flags, disjointness and span union.

Overlap mask admits only CPUs whose sibling child span equals group span; first user installs capacity mask, later verify equality; capacities seed one base unit per member with min/max at base; descendant search stays inside target then skips equal-span levels later pruned.

Group lookup reuses descriptors via refs, initing span and capacity from child or single CPU; capacity prep derives weight, cores and packing preference; domain init intersects allowed with level membership; construction links child/parent, enlarges on violation and resolves relax thresholds from defaults.

Non-NUMA levels must be identical or disjoint by lowest member; asymmetry counts spans inside versus outside; NUMA imbalance derives from cache density scaled upward; shared scan takes unclaimed or compatible slot with diagnostic reuse on exhaustion, asymmetric path via nearest fully asymmetric non-NUMA ancestor.

Levels iterate via descriptor with membership callback, name, NUMA depth and tables until terminator; storage provisions per-level per-CPU objects node-local plus per-CPU shared; claiming detaches used objects; release frees only acquired stages reverse; root inits masks/bandwidth/trackers with reverse unwind and deferred free; task-group cache immutable after init; default root holds one ref.

Boot validates class order stop>deadline>realtime>fair>idle with ext between fair and idle when present, prepares wait/groups/domains/bandwidth, configures runqueues zeroed detached full capacity, and marks running; new deadline rq empty with ratio full when RT unbounded else scaled; fair/ext servers bind embedded entity; ext and rescue have full versus no-op duals; wait entries start empty; effective prio preserves RT/DL else normal; stats conditional.

Fair unregister releases bandwidth, detaches present load averages and removes queued runqueues from leaf tracking under runqueue lock and IRQ-safe; removal syncs blocked average then folds util, load and runnable into removal counters.

locks.text: Regular group building requires domains mutex; replaced chains and roots are destroyed only after grace period.
Task-group bookkeeping has dedicated spinlock; bandwidth destroy is no-op when uninitialized else cancels timers and drains throttle work IRQ-safe.

state_machines.text: Nice update validates range and serializes against scheduling; group release unregisters fair and realtime portions then defers final free through RCU grace.

structs.text: Groups link circularly with own refs to shared capacity with own refs; shared frees on last drop; NUMA domains get private overlapping groups from child spans, others reuse per-CPU groups wrapped and linked circularly; old chains reclaim after grace.
Dispatch queue carries identity, owner, lock, list and per-CPU extensions linked back with deferred requeue; idle tracking uses global, per-node and per-CPU local, cache and NUMA masks.
Pressure group carries enable state, averaging window and lock, average triggers with counts and deferred work, polling triggers with lock and list, period limits, wake queue, timer and task pointer.
